supportedStates: source-only: default, hover, focused, focused-filled, disabled, filled, ranged
contentStress: not-applicable: no production or executable Calendar contract exists

sourceClaims.claim: Date-Picker is a 20-variant source Component Set with Size, State, Filled and Ranged axes
Calendar.svg is a separate 2081x2386 additional-reference canvas with metadata-only semantic analysis; the indexed Interface / Calendar component is only a 24x24 icon
Picker-Dropdown has separate 280x274 one-month and 560x274 two-month source compositions, while Picker-Cell/Month has fourteen 30x30 exported state combinations
the repository does not promote either source into a reusable component without a separately designed date-domain and interaction API

evidence.source-integrity: pass: raw Date-Picker and Calendar sources are present, indexed and unchanged
evidence.structural-contract: partial-pass: framework-neutral Calendar and Date Field behaviors and their executable fixtures are classified; Date Picker, styles, Showcase and consumer evidence remain pending
evidence.runtime-browser: partial-pass: standalone Calendar navigation, selection and keyboard focus plus Date Field localized editing, stable form submission, validation and reset pass focused Chromium contracts
evidence.accessibility: partial-pass: standalone Calendar exposes named region/grid/month and programmatic states; Date Field exposes native label, description, invalid error, disabled and read-only semantics; automated audit and manual walk remain pending
evidence.focused-visual: not-applicable: source-only SVG composition is not a production component fidelity target
evidence.responsive-content-stress: not-applicable: locale, viewport, month transition and form integration require a future scoped implementation

staticVisual: pass: source index records the static Date-Picker axes and Calendar composition without runtime claims
realInteractionVisual: partial-pass: standalone Calendar keyboard and selection behavior is executable; visual fidelity is pending
runtimeBehavior: partial-pass: Calendar and Date Field locale, selection/editing, validation and change events have library APIs; Date Picker composition remains pending

knownLimitations: Calendar and Date Field behaviors are implemented without the source-backed visual layer; Date Picker, responsive presentation, consumers and completion evidence remain in progress
